backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only free signal-date OHLCV and a deterministic trading calendar: last trading day through first three trading days, SPY-relative leadership, close/volume/volatility guards, same-ticker selected-core overlap exclusion, top-1/day, next-open paper entry, and 10-trading-day close exit through the shared fill/cost model.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus shared default-off paper helper overlay

runtime_fields: complete loaded trading calendar for historical month-end labels
explicit calendar_dates or known_month_end_dates for daily month-end labels
same-day baseline A/B entries for overlap metadata
same-day core A/B ticker for same-ticker overlap exclusion

gate3.note: No new core filter is added. The helper is default-off paper; core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: candidate_pool/shared_adapter: turn-of-month institutional contribution and rebalance flow should make liquid sector-known stocks that already show 20-day SPY-relative leadership and a high signal-day close continue after next-open entry. exp026 showed this as a positive free calendar/OHLCV replay lead; exp027 only tests whether the fixed policy bundle survives shared default-off historical/daily semantics.
interpretation: The positive turn-of-month liquid leadership lead reproduced through a shared default-off helper and daily snapshot API.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not sweep month-start/end day counts, ret20/ret60 leadership thresholds, close-location, volume bounds, volatility bounds, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional on the frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Next useful evidence is closed forward replacement-value rows from the shared default-off ledger or a genuinely new point-in-time flow beneficiary field, not another threshold retune.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The shared helper reproduced the private replay lead because it kept the exact calendar window, liquid sector-known universe, SPY-relative leadership, close/volume/volatility guards, same-ticker selected-core overlap exclusion, next-open entry, 10-day exit, cost, top-1, and cooldown semantics while adding daily pending/open/closed state handling with month-end fail-closed calendar parity.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/shared_adapter: turn-of-month institutional contribution and rebalance flow should make liquid sector-known stocks that already show 20-day SPY-relative leadership and a high signal-day close continue after next-open entry. exp026 showed this as a positive free calendar/OHLCV replay lead; exp027 only tests whether the fixed policy bundle survives shared default-off historical/daily semantics.

2_history_check.exp-20260606-020: Accepted macro relief leadership shared adapter; nearby evidence that event/calendar timing can work when not retuned on frozen windows.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-019: Accepted volatility relief leadership shared adapter; useful neighbor showing free OHLCV leadership can be default-off production-visible when replay and daily semantics share a helper.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-013: Accepted narrow-range compression shared adapter: aggregate EV +0.1608 and PnL +$2,248.98. This run must reproduce exp026, therefore retaining the stronger comparator outcome.
2_history_check.exp-20260609-026: Positive replay lead: aggregate EV +0.2774, PnL +$5,287.69, 73 target trades, all three canonical windows positive, and accepted compression comparator beaten. It was not promoted because no shared helper/daily snapshot/parity path existed.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no EV/PnL regression window, sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, accepted compression comparator remains beaten, and the shared helper must reproduce exp026 within drift tolerance.

prediction.confidence_reason: The fixed exp-20260609-026 bundle already improved all three canonical windows and beat the accepted compression comparator; the main risk is implementation drift when moving from private runner logic to a shared default-off helper.

activation_envelope.capital_cap: no live capital; future activation must cap portfolio exposure
activation_envelope.intended_notional: default-off paper only at fixed $4,000 notional
activation_envelope.kill_switch: future activation requires closed forward replacement-value gate plus drawdown/concentration kill switch
activation_envelope.liquidity_slippage_model: historical replay uses price >= $10, ADV20 >= $75M, next-open entry, target-side sell slippage, and round-trip cost
activation_envelope.order_semantics: no orders emitted; pending/open/closed paper ledger only
activation_envelope.portfolio_displacement: paper overlay versus cash/core baseline only; no live displacement

production_impact.calendar_parity_note: Historical replay passes the full loaded trading calendar into the shared helper. Daily snapshots must not infer last-trading-day labels from truncated OHLCV; month-end observation requires explicit calendar_dates or known_month_end_dates and otherwise fails closed.
production_impact.daily_snapshot_note: quant/turn_of_month_liquid_leadership_paper_sleeve.py exposes the daily default-off snapshot API. quant/run.py is intentionally unchanged in this experiment because live/default order paths must remain untouched.
production_impact.parity_note: Historical replay and daily observation share quant/turn_of_month_liquid_leadership_paper_sleeve.py. The helper is default-off and cannot alter orders, core ranking, sizing, exits, watchlists, LLM, or news behavior.
